title: Gingerbread House Village Clipart PNG
author: KIDS ZONE
description:
Gingerbread House Village Clipart PNG – High-Resolution Digital Clipart Bundle
Celebrate the joy of holiday confectionery crafting, festive baking, and sweet winter teamwork with this Gingerbread House Village Clipart collection. Rendered in rich cookie watercolors, frosted royal icing, and delightful Christmas character styling, this 19-piece series depicts cheerful girls constructing a gingerbread wonderland. Scenes showcase sweet baker girls carrying gingerbread cottages, candy cane girls standing proudly beside holiday houses, girls holding giant sugared gumdrops, trio of friends decorating candy roofs, girls hugging gingerbread men, and decorating candy chimneys.
🎨 What’s Included:
* 19 Individual High-Quality PNG Images
* Transparent Backgrounds
* 300 DPI High Resolution for Crisp, Clear Printing
* Approximately 15″ x 18″ (4500 x 5400 px) Canvas Size
* Instant Digital Download
✨ Perfect For:
Christmas cookie decorating party invitations, holiday family greeting cards, gingerbread festival banners, holiday kitchen prints, baker aprons, mugs, and sublimation craft blanks.
⚠️ Please Note:
* This is a digital download; no physical product will be shipped.
* Colors may vary slightly depending on your monitor and printer settings.
* Preview images and mockups are for presentation purposes only.
